## Summary

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18).
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions — confirmed `status: rolled_out` with v2.3.0 in all three regions.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after deploy of v2.3.1") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged.
- Note: the first incident creation attempt timed out and no incident was recorded, so I retried and confirmed INC-0002 was opened successfully.

No change-manager approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version, not a new deploy.
